name: bu-v2-explore-20
description: 20 BU Bench V2.1 tasks for quick explorations; compare configurations on the same frozen list so new runs pair with old ones.
method: Drop tasks with no signal (every configuration within 0.05, or all below 0.1), split the rest into four difficulty bands by mean score, and sample 5 tasks per band (seed 20260929) at random from the cheaper half. Random within bands, not top-discrimination: cross-validated on held-out configurations, cherry-picking the most discriminating tasks called clear differences wrong 7-9% of the time against 1.6% (20 tasks) and 0.1% (40 tasks) for random, because a single run's score has about 0.17 noise (test-retest r=0.78).
